# Page

The deliverable ships as one HTML page — landing or campaign, site, single-view tool, dashboard, document or report, poster, media frames, utility view — and this is also the answer when you cannot tell which deliverable is wanted. Slides are [deck](deck.md); separate screens in a flow are [app](app.md). Then [check](check.md).

## What a page owes

One HTML file `{项目名}.html`; decide yourself whether anything else is needed. Pages and app files carry no deck markers (`section.slide`, `data-deck-slide`) and no deck/slide/ppt in their names. Operate the navigation, the primary action and every filter, toggle, tab and form it carries. A complex layout is also audited at the widths between, e.g. `1440,1024,768,390`.
